title: New in Symfony 8.2: Messenger improvements
content:
<html><head></head><body>Symfony 8.2 is a huge release for the Messenger component. We already
introduced the outbox and claim check options, the Messenger inbox,
Messenger flows, cross-application messaging, signed transports,
faster workers and the MongoDB transport. This article…</body></html>
author: Javier Eguiluz
